# Minnesota Timberwolves 2026/27 Season Preview: Going For It With LaMelo Ball

Locked On Fantasy Basketball, 2026-08-19, 33:09. https://youtu.be/2mxpEpGU3H8

## Summary

Josh Lloyd and Ben Beacon (Locked On Wolves) preview the 2026/27 Minnesota Timberwolves after the trade that brought in LaMelo Ball and sent out Julius Randle and Naz Reid. Ben expects Anthony Edwards to move off the ball more, which should mean more catch-and-shoot threes, while LaMelo runs the offense. The fifth starter is still open. Ben guesses Josh Green over Ayo Dosunmu, with Trey Lyles and later rookie Joan Beringer as power forward options. Donte DiVincenzo is out until about March. Ben says LaMelo's health decides the team's ceiling, and he predicts 53 wins. Josh warns that Minnesota has a two-game week in the middle of every possible fantasy playoff window, so Edwards and Ball should drop slightly in close draft decisions.

## Rules and methods

- [32:22](https://youtu.be/2mxpEpGU3H8?t=1942) Check fantasy playoff schedules. If a team has a two-game week during the fantasy playoffs, move its players down a little when choosing between them and similar players.
  > "if there's tiebre decisions between Anthony Edwards and someone else, Lamelo Ball and someone else, drop them down a little bit"
- [32:13](https://youtu.be/2mxpEpGU3H8?t=1933) Minnesota has a two-game week in the middle of the fantasy playoffs no matter which weeks a head-to-head league uses, so it is hard to avoid.

- [30:58](https://youtu.be/2mxpEpGU3H8?t=1858) League quality is up and tanking incentives are down. That could mean fewer easy wins late in the season and lower win totals for good teams.
